seoTitle: Google Consent Mode v2 Snippet Builder (gtag)
metaDescription: Generate gtag consent default and update code for ad_storage, analytics_storage, ad_user_data and ad_personalization. Free, copy and paste.
intro: Generates the Google Consent Mode v2 default and update code with all four main signals, optional regions, wait_for_update and ads_data_redaction.
why:
Google tags need to know the visitor's consent state before they load. Consent Mode v2 added two signals, ad_user_data and ad_personalization, next to ad_storage and analytics_storage.

This tool writes the default call, the update function for your banner to call, and the optional settings. The default must run before the Google tag or Tag Manager loads, otherwise the tag starts without it. The code does not collect consent: that is the job of your consent banner.
howTo: Choose the default for each signal. Denied is the usual starting point in the EU.
Set a region list if the default should only apply to some places.
Copy the script above your Google tag snippet.
Call updateConsent from your banner when the visitor chooses.
